Kwame Adjei-Rowe: the Moss Coastal digest dated Nov 2, 2025 says Pellucid Harbor Logistics' account ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". So the date is **November 3, 2025**.

The digest doesn't name you as the new owner. The Coastal cheat sheet lists PHL as a Coastal account but doesn't name an owner either. I can't confirm from these files that it moved to you. Check the CRM's assignment history before you enter it.

Don't confuse this account with Covey & Lark Retail. It also uses the "PHL" shorthand.
